name: snp-memory-agent
description: Connects an AI coding agent to the SNP Memory System: a dual-layer institutional memory of a compiled Git wiki (Layer 1) and a PostgreSQL pgvector data vault reachable only through Scout's rag_fetch (Layer 2).

rbac.note: A tool argument may narrow the caller's departments but never expand them. The document ACL value `all` is not caller authority.

requiredTools.note: The tools each server in mcp.json must actually offer. snpmemory and scout are built in-process and introspected by tests/test_agent_package.py::test_the_manifest_lists_the_local_servers_real_tools; snp-wiki is a container and is introspected by tests/integration/test_wiki_tool_surface_live.py. Naming the tests is the point: an earlier version of this note claimed every server was checked while only one was, and `list_notes` sat here for weeks without being served.

ships.note: The authoritative list of what this package distributes. A component missing from the package, or present but undeclared, fails tests/test_agent_package_sync.py. The 25-file gap this closes was an accident that no test could see.

repoLocal.note: Deliberately NOT distributed. The superpowers layer is this repository's own development discipline, not part of the memory system's operating contract. Shipping it would tell a consumer's agent to write brainstorms and plans into their `artifacts/superpowers/`, for work that has nothing to do with the memory system. It lives in `.agent/` and stays there: `.claude/` deliberately omits it, because Claude Code runs the `unlazy` gate discipline and carrying both put two conflicting completion protocols in one session. tests/test_agent_package_sync.py enforces that absence in both directions.
